objectIds.description: Array of model object IDs to return dependency data for. Non-existent IDs are silently ignored.

objectLabels.description: Key-value label pairs used to select objects. Objects matching any of the provided pairs are returned (OR semantics).

tagIds.description: Filter dependency objects to those matching any of the given tag IDs.

technologyIds.description: Filter dependency objects to those matching any of the given technology IDs.
